params.caption: Bollywood dance-pop, Bollywood EDM, Hindi pop. Festive, playful, energetic. Bright confident female vocal, punchy rhythmic verses and a big chant-along hook, sung in Hindi, with choir harmonies in the chorus. Brass section, rich punchy dhol drums, dholak, punchy electronic drums and deep synth bass. Dhol build intro, groovy verses, build pre-chorus. Loud punchy club mix. immediate rhythmic identity, group call-and-response, short percussion break before the final chorus. Vocal forward, natural phrasing.
